item.content:encoded:
It made me exhale out of my nose a little, and considering how few -J’s manage that I’d say it’s deserving of a +1.

That’s not to say it’s without fault. The wording is a little clunky at times, which if I recall correctly seems to be a consistent issue with your writing. Certain words feel like filler, and whilst harmless on their own it does congeal into a tiresome read. Examples below.

+ show block
– hide block

Any attempts to use SCP-016-J outside of testing are prohibited, however conversing with SCP-016-J is allowed (but not encouraged).

Read this sentence aloud. It comes across as a bit jarring. Perhaps something like ‘Use of SCP-016-J outside of testing is prohibited. Conversation is (whilst not encouraged) permitted.’? It ain’t perfect by any means but it’s more concise. Actually, whilst we’re on the subject of this line, why does it need to exist in the first place? I get that it’s a -J and doesn’t have to obey the same stringent qualifiers that a standard article does, but sentences that basically say ‘don’t use it’ are kind of a no-brainer and don’t really need to be explicitly stated. It’d be like specifying that a containment cell needs to have four walls.

SCP-016-J is a ballistic missile approximately 2.4 meters tall, and 0.3 meters in diameter.

Just picking nits- this comma is unnecessary.

Yes you’re the biggest missile I’ve ever seen.

A comma after ‘Yes’ is necessary.

You’re afraid because I’m the biggest missile you’ve ever seen. You don’t know how much I’m going to hurt.

I think this could have been pushed further (har har) for comedic effect. Maybe it’s just my style of humour leaking through, but when you have a funny interaction like this I think ramping it up to a ridiculous extreme benefits the written format. Maybe the missile rants about how it’s going to destroy the facility, maybe it starts talking about specific model details as if they’re like… ‘penis features’? Whatever, you see my point- this part fell a little flat.

Lay down a nice stream of napalm in there.

This is gross, not particularly funny, and doesn’t really make any sense. I’d cut it, personally.

Talk ballistic to me.

What? This line is even more nonsensical. Isn’t this like the equivalent of a human saying ‘talk person to me’ because it’s just describing the thing it is? If you’re going to use this analogy, use it properly.

At the end of the day it’s a poorly written dick joke. I do kind of dig it though, in a weird way. Something charming about how much punch it packs in that short word count. Good work, but don’t get too confident- I hope to see your writing improve in your next piece, whatever and whenever it may be.
